name: Member's Mark Atlantic Salmon Burgers (Frozen 8-Pack)
whyItWorks: Atlantic salmon patties ground with light seasoning. They cook up moist and flaky, providing bioavailable anti-inflammatory marine fats without tough meat fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear in a nonstick skillet with a little olive oil. Serve on a plain brioche or white hamburger bun.
